title: Ordered free comparison for every normalized symmetric Proj quotient
statement: For a scheme S, an arbitrary quasi-coherent O_S-module E, and any normalized TautologicalQuotient D on Proj_S Sym(E) [def-per-projective-bundle-quotient-data], HasFreeCompatibility D holds. For every r >= 0 and ordered isomorphism b:O_S^(r+1) -> E, there are isomorphisms eRel to RelativeProjectiveSpace.scheme S r and eStd to standard projective space P^(r)_S over S, and an isomorphism from the pulled standard twist O(1) to D.line. The pulled quotient on the ith basis vector equals the pulled coordinate section T_i through this isomorphism. On every affine V, AffineFreeComparison r b eRel V holds with the coefficient- and generator-preserving graded polynomial isomorphism beta, its induced Proj morphism, the degree-one-section-preserving twist comparison, and the defining RelativeProjectiveSpace polynomial chart gamma and eR. The statement includes r=0 and empty charts.

proof.text: Fix r and b. Apply [lem-trf-symmetric-proj-ordered-relative-comparison] to get eRel over S and every affine polynomial/twist comparison. Obtain the normalized standard-model isomorphism theta from the existing [lem-trf-free-projective-bundle-base-change-space]. Apply [lem-trf-symmetric-proj-ordered-twist-gluing] to those comparisons and the given normalized quotient D to obtain t and all coordinate equations. Set eStd=eRel followed by theta. Its over-base equation follows by associativity and the over-base equations for eRel and theta. The remaining fields of HasFreeCompatibility are the already obtained witnesses and equations.

mathlib_searches.results: Projectivization, LinearAlgebra.Projectivization.termℙ, Projectivization.rep, Projectivization.mk', Projectivization.mk, Projectivization.finite_iff_of_finite, Projectivization.mk_rep, Projectivization.Subspace. None is the scheme-theoretic comparison.

No matches. Inspected ProjectiveSpectrum.Basic, Scheme, and Modules.Tilde: these provide absolute Proj, charts and module restriction, not the specialized relative quotient comparison. Whole-blueprint searches for normalized quotient, relative proj twists, and projective space bundle give no exact blueprint statement. The finite-locally-free frame-model node has stronger hypotheses and a different realization, so cannot replace arbitrary-E descent.
